text: Resumed P5 external-evidence audit. The authorized Slurm 26.05.2 Docker command cleared approval but never reached the engine: after a bounded wait, cancellation exposed a blocked local-socket _ping; a separate five-second socket probe timed out with zero bytes while Docker backend processes/socket were present. The acceptance record now preserves this diagnostic without claiming an image. Current v1 local gate remains green: matrix and fake-site harness, formatting, 154 Scala 3.7.4 tests, and worker package.
